snippet.title: AI LIMIT: Eirene's Furnace of War Free DLC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
AI LIMIT's free DLC Eirene's Furnace of War is available now on PS5 and PC.

Alongside new story content, players can unlock a range of new weapons, armor, and Spells within the Furnace of War, enabling more diverse and flexible combat builds.

The DLC also introduces new challenge modes, allowing players to take on previously defeated bosses as well as new enemies from Eirene's Furnace of War across multiple difficulty settings. Completing these challenges will grant additional rewards.
